errors.text_span: 不同语体（新闻、传统文学、网络小说、微博）

errors.text_span: 在图（a）中，柱状图的高度代表支配动词的总频次，其中“新闻”语体的柱状图最高，约达6800次，而“微博”语体最低，约1500次；在图（b）中，柱状图高度代表承受动词的总频次，其中“新闻”语体柱状图最高，约6500次，而“微博”语体最低，约1000次
errors.evidence: The specific totals and ranking are wrong: the left panel has highest bars around 4500/6500+ and the right panel’s highest bar is for 网络小说, not 新闻; the lowest bars are not as stated. Several quoted totals do not match the plotted bar heights.

errors.text_span: 如“新闻”语体中“动作”语义域占比约46%

The description does not mention the actual visible title/caption relationship accurately enough; it reframes the chart as about dominated/subordinate verbs rather than the figure’s stated topic of first-level semantic-domain distribution across registers.
